scenarios.name: Docker Compose
checks: startup, readiness, manifest UI default and unauthenticated denial
landing, workspace and task controls served through deployment proxy
private CLI code, HTTPS/SSH-forwarded login, cookie policy, replay and proxy admin denial
CSRF, real draft persistence and unbuffered SSE
SIGTERM with SSE, persistent restart, session/code revocation and no automatic spending
storage outage returns 503 while liveness stays up; recovery and private file modes
quiesced backup copied and restored into a new data directory
process crash/restart preserves restored state
restored task, logout-all, frontend OFF and credential-free service logs

limitations: No containers, namespaces, cgroups, actual read-only mounts, platform edge routing or cloud account deployment
SSH forwarding transport modeled by a local proxy; SSH authentication is not emulated
Fixed platform ports and data paths remapped to private temporary resources
No model inference, marketplace calls or payments; no production demo-mode override
